# ServiceOS

> Professional business management system for orders, inventory, staff, bookings, debtors, and operations — built for hospitality and service businesses.

ServiceOS helps owners and operators run daily operations: take orders, manage menus and inventory, track tabs and debtors, handle bookings, and review financial reports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point to ServiceOS.
- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign-in and registration for business operators.
